title: Concept: Redash console is reachable without authentication
description: A Redash instance holds the connection strings for each query runner. Reaching the UI is therefore a step away from running arbitrary statements against every attached warehouse, and from reading saved queries that name internal tables.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller enumerates data sources and runs queries against them, then reads the saved queries that document the schema.
